description: Victoria's waste and resource recovery infrastructure map data is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Recycling Victoria. This dataset details the current locations of Victoria’s waste, recycling and resource recovery infrastructure facilities, including: landfills hazardous waste facilities material recovery facilities (MRF) resource recovery centres (also known as transfer stations) reprocessors. For each infrastructure facility, the dataset includes: name facility type infrastructure type facility owner address. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Recycling Victoria. Its tags are Landfill, Recycling, Recycling Industry, Waste, hazardous waste. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-02-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
